title: Clarify which folder-admission refusal precedes unsupported planning fields
outcome: The planning-field matrix states that reconciliation holds and shared note/activity refusals take precedence over unsupported_fields, while preserving whole-task refusal semantics.
acceptance: The Git task-sync planning-field matrix describes the current folder_admission::apply_on refusal order: reconciliation hold, shared note/activity admission, then unsupported_fields; field names are distinguished from refusal reason codes.
The clarification preserves whole-task value protection, follows current source, and passes the repository's documentation validation and review requirements.
